property_summary: For any depositor and any withdraw amount <= their recorded balance, after withdraw completes the contract's total stored ledger sum (sum of balances mapping) equals the contract's ether balance; the buggy mutant that omits decrement can make the mapping sum larger than the contract balance (double-paid), violating this conservation for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the balance decrement entirely so balances are not reduced after withdraw, changing subsequent observable behavior.
